<script>
(function () {
  var SB = window.supabase.createClient(
    'https://vpqbkvolturanicmgjmv.supabase.co',
    'sb_publishable_AIzx9T0YHFUN7Z2cpRhSzg_R7zq_gUr'
  );
  var COURSE = 'wash-3';
  var COURSE_TITLE = 'Cleaning Course Level 3: Introduction';
  var SITE = 'https://semicon-campus.com/';
  // List of lessons. When a new lesson is published, add it here (also register its quiz in the tests table on Supabase)
  var LESSONS = [
    { slug: 'semiconductor-why-wafer-cleaning', title: 'Why Is Semiconductor Cleaning Needed So Many Times? The Role of the Cleaning Process' },
    { slug: 'cleanroom-class-contamination-sources', title: 'How to Read Cleanroom "Cleanliness" and Where Contamination Gets In', sub: true },
    { slug: 'semiconductor-wafer-contamination-types', title: '4 Types of Contamination Removed by Cleaning: Particles, Organics, Metals, and Native Oxide' },
    { slug: 'native-oxide-hf-last-hydrogen-termination', title: 'How Fast Does Native Oxide Come Back? The Surface After HF and "Hydrogen Termination"', sub: true },
    { slug: 'rca-clean-sc1-sc2', title: 'The Basics of RCA Cleaning: What SC-1 and SC-2 Contain and Why the Order Matters' },
    { slug: 'rca-clean-history-sc1-particle-removal', title: 'The History of RCA Cleaning and Why SC-1 Removes Particles', sub: true },
    { slug: 'wet-cleaning-problems-dry-cleaning', title: 'Challenges in Semiconductor Cleaning: The Risk of Over-Cleaning and Dry Cleaning' },
    { slug: 'batch-vs-single-wafer-cleaning-one-bath', title: 'Batch vs. Single-Wafer Cleaning: From Multi-Bath to One-Bath Systems', sub: true },
    { slug: 'wafer-cleanliness-measurement', title: 'How Cleaning Is Evaluated: Measuring Particles, Metals, and Organics' },
    { slug: 'txrf-total-reflection-xray-fluorescence-basics', title: 'How TXRF Works: Measuring Metals on the Wafer Surface with Total Reflection', sub: true },
    { slug: 'ultrapure-water-rinse-drying-watermark', title: 'Rinsing and Drying in Semiconductor Cleaning: Ultrapure Water and Watermarks' },
    { slug: 'wafer-cleaning-chemical-safety-hydrofluoric-acid', title: 'Chemical Safety in Cleaning: Hydrofluoric Acid Is Dangerous Even When It Doesn\'t Hurt' }
  ];
  var MAINS = LESSONS.filter(function (l) { return !l.sub; });
  var HOME = location.href.split('#')[0];
  var root = document.getElementById('sc-app');
  var recovering = false;
  var state = { user: null, course: null, tests: [], attempts: [], reads: {} };

  var BTN = 'padding:9px 18px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:#1a5fb4;color:#fff;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer;margin:4px 8px 4px 0';
  var BTN2 = BTN.replace('#1a5fb4', '#666');
  var BTN3 = 'padding:6px 12px;border:1px solid #1a5fb4;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;color:#1a5fb4;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;margin:2px 6px 2px 0';
  var INP = 'display:block;width:100%;padding:10px;margin:6px 0 12px;border:1px solid #bbb;border-radius:6px;font-size:16px;box-sizing:border-box';
  var CARD = 'margin:14px 0;padding:14px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:10px;background:#fff';

  function el(tag, attrs, kids) {
    var e = document.createElement(tag);
    Object.keys(attrs || {}).forEach(function (k) {
      if (k === 'text') e.textContent = attrs[k];
      else if (k === 'on') Object.keys(attrs.on).forEach(function (ev) { e.addEventListener(ev, attrs.on[ev]); });
      else e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]);
    });
    (kids || []).forEach(function (c) { e.appendChild(c); });
    return e;
  }
  function clear() { while (root.firstChild) root.removeChild(root.firstChild); }
  function btn(text, style, fn) { return el('button', { text: text, style: style, on: { click: fn } }); }
  function fmtDate(s) { var d = new Date(s); return d.getFullYear() + '/' + (d.getMonth() + 1) + '/' + d.getDate(); }
  function jp(m) {
    if (/invalid format|valid email/i.test(m)) return 'The email address format is not valid. Example: name@example.com';
    if (/Invalid login/i.test(m)) return 'The email address or password is incorrect. If you have not signed up yet, press "Sign up".';
    if (/already registered/i.test(m)) return 'This email address is already registered. Press "Log in".';
    if (/Password should/i.test(m)) return 'Your password must be at least 8 characters.';
    if (/Email not confirmed/i.test(m)) return 'You have not opened the link in the confirmation email yet. Please check your email.';
    if (/rate limit/i.test(m)) return 'Too many requests in a short time. Please wait a while and try again.';
    return 'An error occurred: ' + m;
  }

  // ---------- Login ----------
  function showAuth(msg) {
    clear();
    var email = el('input', { type: 'email', placeholder: 'Email address', style: INP, autocomplete: 'email' });
    var pass = el('input', { type: 'password', placeholder: 'Password (at least 8 characters)', style: INP, autocomplete: 'current-password' });
    var note = el('p', { text: msg || '', style: 'color:#b00020' });
    function run(kind) {
      var em = email.value.trim(), at = em.indexOf('@');
      if (Math.max(0, 1 - at) !== 0 || Math.max(0, at + 2 - em.indexOf('.', at)) !== 0 || em.indexOf(' ') !== -1 || em.charAt(em.length - 1) === '.') { note.style.color = '#b00020'; note.textContent = 'The email address format is not valid. Example: name@example.com'; return; }
      if (Math.max(0, 8 - pass.value.length) !== 0) { note.style.color = '#b00020'; note.textContent = 'Your password must be at least 8 characters.'; return; }
      note.style.color = '#333';
      note.textContent = 'Processing…';
      var p = kind === 'up'
        ? SB.auth.signUp({ email: em, password: pass.value, options: { emailRedirectTo: HOME } })
        : SB.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: em, password: pass.value });
      p.then(function (r) {
        if (r.error) { note.style.color = '#b00020'; note.textContent = jp(r.error.message); return; }
        if (kind === 'up' ? !r.data.session : false) {
          note.style.color = '#1a5fb4';
          note.textContent = 'We sent you a confirmation email. Open the link in the email, then log in.';
          return;
        }
        boot();
      });
    }
    root.appendChild(el('h3', { text: COURSE_TITLE }));
    root.appendChild(el('p', { text: 'Sign up (free) or log in to use quizzes, the level-up test, and your learning record.' }));
    root.appendChild(el('label', { text: 'Email address (e.g., name@example.com)' })); root.appendChild(email);
    root.appendChild(el('label', { text: 'Password (at least 8 characters)' })); root.appendChild(pass);
    root.appendChild(el('p', { text: 'New here? Enter your details and press "Sign up" (free). Already registered? Press "Log in".', style: 'font-size:14px;color:#555;margin:0 0 8px' }));
    root.appendChild(btn('Log in', BTN, function () { run('in'); }));
    root.appendChild(btn('Sign up', BTN2, function () { run('up'); }));
    root.appendChild(btn('Forgot your password?', 'border:0;background:none;color:#1a5fb4;text-decoration:underline;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;padding:4px 0', function () {
      var em2 = email.value.trim();
      if (Math.max(0, 1 - em2.indexOf('@')) !== 0) { note.style.color = '#b00020'; note.textContent = 'Enter your registered email in the email field above, then press this again.'; return; }
      SB.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(em2, { redirectTo: HOME }).then(function (r) {
        note.style.color = r.error ? '#b00020' : '#1a5fb4';
        note.textContent = r.error ? jp(r.error.message) : 'We sent you a password reset email. Please open the link in the email.';
      });
    }));
    root.appendChild(note);
  }

  function showReset() {
    clear();
    var np = el('input', { type: 'password', placeholder: 'New password (at least 8 characters)', style: INP, autocomplete: 'new-password' });
    var nt = el('p', { text: '', style: 'color:#b00020' });
    root.appendChild(el('h3', { text: 'Set a new password' }));
    root.appendChild(np);
    root.appendChild(btn('Change password', BTN, function () {
      if (Math.max(0, 8 - np.value.length) !== 0) { nt.textContent = 'Your password must be at least 8 characters.'; return; }
      SB.auth.updateUser({ password: np.value }).then(function (r) {
        if (r.error) { nt.textContent = 'An error occurred: ' + r.error.message; return; }
        recovering = false;
        boot();
      });
    }));
    root.appendChild(nt);
  }

  // ---------- Data loading ----------
  function load() {
    return SB.from('courses').select('id,title').eq('slug', COURSE).single().then(function (c) {
      if (c.error) throw new Error('course');
      state.course = c.data;
      return Promise.all([
        SB.from('tests').select('id,kind,chapter_slug,title,pass_percent,sort').eq('course_id', c.data.id).order('sort'),
        SB.from('attempts').select('test_id,score,total,passed,taken_at').order('taken_at', { ascending: false }),
        SB.from('progress').select('article_slug,read_at')
      ]);
    }).then(function (res) {
      state.tests = res[0].data || [];
      state.attempts = res[1].data || [];
      state.reads = {};
      (res[2].data || []).forEach(function (p) { state.reads[p.article_slug] = true; });
    });
  }
  function bestFor(testId) {
    var best = null;
    state.attempts.forEach(function (a) {
      if (a.test_id === testId) { if (!best || Math.max(0, a.score - best.score) !== 0) best = a; }
    });
    return best;
  }
  function testBySlug(slug) { return state.tests.filter(function (t) { return t.chapter_slug === slug; })[0]; }
  function levelTest() { return state.tests.filter(function (t) { return t.kind === 'level'; })[0]; }
  function levelPassed() {
    var lt = levelTest();
    if (!lt) return null;
    var hit = state.attempts.filter(function (a) { return a.test_id === lt.id ? a.passed : false; });
    return hit.length ? hit[hit.length - 1] : null;
  }

  // ---------- Shared navigation ----------
  function nav(current) {
    var bar = el('div', { style: 'display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin:0 0 10px;padding-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd' });
    bar.appendChild(btn('Course', current === 'home' ? BTN : BTN3, showHome));
    bar.appendChild(btn('My page', current === 'my' ? BTN : BTN3, showMy));
    bar.appendChild(btn('Log out', BTN3, function () { SB.auth.signOut().then(function () { showGuest(); }); }));
    root.appendChild(bar);
  }

  // ---------- Course screen ----------
  function showHome() {
    clear();
    nav('home');
    root.appendChild(el('h3', { text: COURSE_TITLE }));
    var done = LESSONS.filter(function (l) { return state.reads[l.slug]; }).length;
    var quizzed = MAINS.filter(function (l) { var t = testBySlug(l.slug); return t ? bestFor(t.id) : false; }).length;
    var lp = levelPassed();
    root.appendChild(el('p', { text: 'Read ' + done + ' / ' + LESSONS.length + '   Quizzes ' + quizzed + ' / ' + MAINS.length + '   Level-up test: ' + (lp ? 'Passed' : 'Not passed'), style: 'font-weight:bold' }));

    var num = 0;
    LESSONS.forEach(function (l, i) {
      if (!l.sub) num++;
      var t = testBySlug(l.slug);
      var b = t ? bestFor(t.id) : null;
      var isRead = !!state.reads[l.slug];
      var card = el('div', { style: CARD });
      card.appendChild(el('div', { text: 'Lesson ' + num + (l.sub ? ' (supplementary)' : ''), style: 'font-size:13px;color:#1a5fb4;font-weight:bold' }));
      card.appendChild(el('a', { href: SITE + l.slug + '/', text: l.title, style: 'font-weight:bold' }));
      var row = el('div', { style: 'margin-top:8px' });
      row.appendChild(btn(isRead ? 'Read (undo)' : 'Mark as read', isRead ? BTN3 : BTN, function () { toggleRead(l.slug, isRead); }));
      if (t) {
        row.appendChild(btn(b ? 'Retake the quiz' : 'Take the quiz', BTN3, function () { showTest(t); }));
        row.appendChild(el('span', { text: b ? 'Best ' + b.score + ' / ' + b.total + ' points' : 'Not taken', style: 'font-size:14px;color:#555' }));
      }
      card.appendChild(row);
      root.appendChild(card);
    });

    var lt = levelTest();
    var box = el('div', { style: CARD + ';border:2px solid #1a5fb4' });
    box.appendChild(el('div', { text: 'Level-up test', style: 'font-size:13px;color:#1a5fb4;font-weight:bold' }));
    box.appendChild(el('div', { text: 'Cleaning Level 3 Level-up test (passing score ' + (lt ? lt.pass_percent : 80) + '%)', style: 'font-weight:bold' }));
    if (lp) box.appendChild(el('p', { text: 'Passed (' + fmtDate(lp.taken_at) + '). ' + lp.score + ' / ' + lp.total + ' points', style: 'color:#0a7a2f;font-weight:bold;margin:6px 0' }));
    var ready = quizzed === MAINS.length;
    if (!ready) box.appendChild(el('p', { text: 'You can take this once you have taken the quiz for every lesson.', style: 'color:#555;margin:6px 0' }));
    if (lt) {
      var go = btn(lp ? 'Take it again' : 'Take the level-up test', ready ? BTN : 'padding:9px 18px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:#aaa;color:#fff;font-size:15px', function () { if (ready) showTest(lt); });
      if (!ready) go.disabled = true;
      box.appendChild(go);
    }
    root.appendChild(box);
  }

    function showGuest() {
    clear();
    root.appendChild(el('h3', { text: COURSE_TITLE }));
    root.appendChild(el('p', { text: 'You can read the lesson articles without signing up. You only need a free account (log in) to use quizzes, the level-up test, and your learning record.' }));
    root.appendChild(btn('Log in / Sign up', BTN, function () { showAuth(); }));
    var gnum = 0;
    LESSONS.forEach(function (l, i) {
      if (!l.sub) gnum++;
      var card = el('div', { style: CARD });
      card.appendChild(el('div', { text: 'Lesson ' + gnum + (l.sub ? ' (supplementary)' : ''), style: 'font-size:13px;color:#1a5fb4;font-weight:bold' }));
      card.appendChild(el('a', { href: SITE + l.slug + '/', text: l.title, style: 'font-weight:bold' }));
      root.appendChild(card);
    });
    root.appendChild(el('p', { text: 'Log in to take the quizzes (one per lesson) and the level-up test.', style: 'color:#555' }));
  }

  function toggleRead(slug, wasRead) {
    var p = wasRead
      ? SB.from('progress').delete().eq('article_slug', slug)
      : SB.from('progress').insert({ article_slug: slug });
    p.then(function () { return load(); }).then(showHome);
  }

  // ---------- Tests ----------
  function showTest(test) {
    clear();
    nav('');
    root.appendChild(el('p', { text: 'Loading questions…' }));
    SB.from('questions').select('id,body,choices').eq('test_id', test.id).eq('published', true).order('id').then(function (q) {
      clear();
      nav('');
      if (q.error || !q.data.length) { root.appendChild(el('p', { text: 'There are no questions yet.' })); return; }
      var qs = q.data;
      // Shuffle the question order on every attempt so multiple-choice and matching questions are not bunched together
      for (var k = qs.length - 1; k !== 0; k--) { var j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (k + 1)); var tmp = qs[k]; qs[k] = qs[j]; qs[j] = tmp; }
      var chosen = {};
      root.appendChild(el('h3', { text: test.title + ' (' + qs.length + ' questions)' }));
      if (test.kind === 'level') root.appendChild(el('p', { text: 'Passing score: ' + test.pass_percent + '%', style: 'color:#555' }));
      qs.forEach(function (item, i) {
        var box = el('div', { style: CARD });
        box.appendChild(el('p', { text: 'Q' + (i + 1) + '. ' + item.body, style: 'font-weight:bold;margin:0 0 8px;white-space:pre-line' }));
        item.choices.forEach(function (ch, idx) {
          var id = 'q' + item.id + '_' + idx;
          var radio = el('input', { type: 'radio', name: 'q' + item.id, id: id, on: { change: function () { chosen[item.id] = idx; } } });
          box.appendChild(el('div', { style: 'margin:4px 0' }, [radio, el('label', { for: id, text: ' ' + ch })]));
        });
        box.appendChild(el('p', { id: 'ex' + item.id, style: 'margin:8px 0 0;display:none' }));
        root.appendChild(box);
      });
      var result = el('p', { style: 'font-weight:bold;font-size:18px' });
      var go = btn('Submit for grading', BTN, function () {
        go.disabled = true;
        result.style.color = '#333';
        result.textContent = 'Grading…';
        SB.rpc('submit_attempt', { p_test_id: test.id, p_answers: chosen }).then(function (r) {
          if (r.error) { go.disabled = false; result.style.color = '#b00020'; result.textContent = 'Grading failed. Please try again.'; return; }
          var byId = {};
          r.data.results.forEach(function (x) { byId[x.question_id] = x; });
          qs.forEach(function (item) {
            var x = byId[item.id];
            if (!x) return;
            var ex = document.getElementById('ex' + item.id);
            ex.style.display = 'block';
            ex.style.color = x.is_correct ? '#0a7a2f' : '#b00020';
            ex.textContent = (x.is_correct ? 'Correct. ' : 'Incorrect. The correct answer is "' + item.choices[x.correct_index] + '". ') + (x.explanation || '');
          });
          var msg = 'Result: ' + r.data.score + ' / ' + r.data.total + ' points';
          if (r.data.passed === true) msg += '   You passed. Congratulations!';
          if (r.data.passed === false) msg += '   You did not pass (passing score ' + r.data.pass_percent + '%). Review the lessons and try again.';
          result.style.color = r.data.passed === false ? '#b00020' : '#0a7a2f';
          result.textContent = msg;
          load().then(function () {
            root.appendChild(btn('Back to the course', BTN, showHome));
          });
        });
      });
      root.appendChild(go);
      root.appendChild(result);
    });
  }

  // ---------- My page ----------
  function showMy() {
    clear();
    nav('my');
    root.appendChild(el('h3', { text: 'My page' }));
    root.appendChild(el('p', { text: 'Logged in as: ' + (state.user ? state.user.email : '') }));
    var lp = levelPassed();
    var done = LESSONS.filter(function (l) { return state.reads[l.slug]; }).length;
    var s = el('div', { style: CARD });
    s.appendChild(el('div', { text: COURSE_TITLE, style: 'font-weight:bold' }));
    s.appendChild(el('p', { text: 'Read: ' + done + ' / ' + LESSONS.length + ' lessons', style: 'margin:6px 0' }));
    s.appendChild(el('p', { text: 'Level-up test: ' + (lp ? 'Passed (' + fmtDate(lp.taken_at) + ')' : 'Not passed yet'), style: 'margin:6px 0;font-weight:bold;color:' + (lp ? '#0a7a2f' : '#555') }));
    s.appendChild(btn('View the course', BTN, showHome));
    root.appendChild(s);

    root.appendChild(el('h4', { text: 'Test history' }));
    if (!state.attempts.length) { root.appendChild(el('p', { text: 'You have not taken any tests yet.', style: 'color:#555' })); return; }
    var titles = {};
    state.tests.forEach(function (t) { titles[t.id] = t.title; });
    state.attempts.slice(0, 30).forEach(function (a) {
      var line = fmtDate(a.taken_at) + '   ' + (titles[a.test_id] || 'Test') + '   ' + a.score + ' / ' + a.total + ' points' + (a.passed === true ? '   Passed' : (a.passed === false ? '   Not passed' : ''));
      root.appendChild(el('div', { text: line, style: 'padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eee;font-size:15px' }));
    });
  }

  // ---------- Startup ----------
  function boot() {
    SB.auth.getSession().then(function (r) {
      if (recovering) return;
      if (!r.data.session) { showGuest(); return; }
      state.user = r.data.session.user;
      clear();
      root.appendChild(el('p', { text: 'Loading…' }));
      load().then(showHome).catch(function () { clear(); root.appendChild(el('p', { text: 'Could not load. Please wait a while and reload the page.', style: 'color:#b00020' })); });
    });
  }
  SB.auth.onAuthStateChange(function (ev) { if (ev === 'PASSWORD_RECOVERY') { recovering = true; showReset(); } });
  boot();
})();
</script>
